title_en: Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation: Call for 44th Cohort Scholars (2027 Academic Year)
summary: Students who will enter the first semester of their second year in Spring 2027 and who meet the income-bracket and GPA requirements may apply for the Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation's 44th cohort scholarship. Applicants must submit the required documents by email to the address given in the original notice by Sunday, 15 November 2026. Students selected as final candidates must then submit documents by 13:00 on Thursday, 19 November 2026.
applies_to: Voluntary application, open only to students who meet all of the following: (1) will be promoted to the first semester of the second year as of Spring 2027 (27-1학기); (2) are within student financial aid support bracket (학자금지원구간) 3 or lower and have a cumulative GPA for all semesters of 3.0/4.3 or higher; (3) will sincerely participate in the foundation's official events and can adapt to community living. Each department (school) may recommend at most 1 student; the College of Engineering plans to recommend 2 students.

dates.what: Deadline for applicants to submit application documents by email
Deadline for each department (school) to submit its single recommended student (recommendation list, Attachment 3)
Departments (schools) are notified of the final recommended candidates
Deadline for final recommended candidates to submit documents

conditions: Each department (school) may recommend at most 1 student; the College of Engineering plans to recommend 2 students in total.
If a department does not reply by the deadline, it is considered to have no recommended student.
If more than 2 students apply within the College of Engineering, eligible applicants are ranked by a combined score of income bracket and cumulative GPA for all semesters.
Ties are broken in this order: income bracket, then GPA of the previous semester, then credits completed in the previous semester.
The scholarship is 5,000,000 KRW per semester and continues until graduation within the regular semesters, provided the foundation's requirements are met.
The scholarship cannot be received at the same time as other external or donated (기탁) scholarships.
The application form and self-introduction must bear the department head's official seal (직인).
The resident registration abstract (주민등록등본) must be issued with the last digits of the resident registration number hidden.
The certificate of basic livelihood recipient or near-poverty status is required only from students to whom it applies.
steps: Read the attached guidance and forms (Attachments 1-1, 2-1, 2-2, 2 and 3); their contents were not read for this translation and must be checked in the original notice.
Confirm that you meet all eligibility requirements (second year, first semester as of Spring 2027; aid bracket 3 or lower; cumulative GPA 3.0/4.3 or higher).

Prepare one copy each of: scholarship application form and self-introduction (Attachment 2) with the department head's official seal; student financial aid support bracket notice; student card (학생카드); academic transcript; resident registration abstract with the last digits of the resident registration number hidden; consent forms for collection, use and provision of personal information for both the foundation and the university (Attachments 2-1 and 2-2); and, if applicable, a certificate of basic livelihood recipient or near-poverty status.
Email the documents to the address given in the original notice by Sunday, 15 November 2026 (the email address and department office contact are in the original notice).
Wait for the notification of final recommended candidates, sent to departments on 17 November 2026 at 11:00.
If you are selected as a final recommended candidate, submit the required documents by 13:00 on Thursday, 19 November 2026 (the notice does not state where; contact the department office).
translation:
Title: Call for the 44th Cohort of Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation Scholars, 2027 Academic Year (until Sun. 15 Nov.)

The Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation is selecting its 44th cohort of scholars for the 2027 academic year as follows. Please submit the relevant documents to [email address — see the original notice].

* Document submission deadline: by Sunday, 15 November 2026

A. Number of recommendations: at most 1 student per department (school). ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend 2 students.

B. Recommendation requirements
1) Students who will be promoted to the first semester of the second year as of Spring 2027 (27-1학기)
2) Within student financial aid support bracket (학자금지원구간) 3 and a cumulative GPA for all semesters of 3.0/4.3 or higher
3) Students who will sincerely participate in the foundation's official events and are able to adapt to community living

C. Scholarship amount: 5,000,000 KRW per semester (supported until graduation within the regular semesters, provided the foundation's requirements are met)
※ Cannot be received concurrently with other external or donated scholarships.

D. Selection procedure
1) Each department (school) recommends at most 1 student (recommendation list, Attachment 3): Monday, 16 November 2026, 11:00
※ If no reply is received by the deadline, the department is considered to have no recommended student.
※ If applications exceed the College of Engineering's quota (2 students), applicants who meet the basic recommendation requirements will be evaluated by the combined score of income bracket and cumulative GPA for all semesters. In the case of a tie, candidates are selected in the order of income bracket, then previous-semester GPA, then previous-semester credits completed.
2) Notification of final recommended candidates to departments (schools): Tuesday, 17 November 2026, 11:00
3) Document submission by final recommended candidates: Thursday, 19 November 2026, 13:00

E. Required documents (one copy each): scholarship application form and self-introduction (including the department head's official seal [학과장 직인]); student financial aid support bracket notice (학자금지원구간통지서); student card (학생카드); academic transcript; resident registration abstract (주민등록등본, issued with the last digits of the resident registration number hidden); consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information (foundation and university); certificate of basic livelihood recipient or near-poverty status (only if applicable).

Attachments (5) — their contents were not read for this translation:
1-1. Guidance on the selection of the 44th Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation scholars (.docx)
2-1. Consent form for the collection and use of personal information and provision to third parties (.docx)
2-2. Consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information (Scholarship and Welfare Office, external foundations) (.hwp)
2. Scholarship application form and self-introduction (.hwp)
3. Scholarship recommendation list (.xlsx)

The contact details of the department office are given in the original notice.
